timeline.labelDe: Aktuelle Ausgabe der DIN 477, die Gasarten ihre Ventilausgangsanschlüsse zuordnet (April 2021)

questions.notes: Card's claim is false: only some gases, above all flammable fuel gases (propane, butane, hydrogen, acetylene …), require left-hand threads (DIN 477); e.g. non-flammable gases use right-hand threads. 'brennbare Gase' accepted.
